items.title: School Intranet: Multi-Tenant Academic Platform
items.desc: An enterprise school management intranet engineered for multi-tenant data isolation, featuring an asynchronous persistence layer with Async SQLAlchemy 2.0 and PostgreSQL (asyncpg), dynamic custom attributes, bilingual i18n support (EN/MM), and automated Telegram & Viber alerts.

techDeepDive.how: Refactored the persistence layer from synchronous execution to Async SQLAlchemy 2.0 with PostgreSQL (asyncpg), eliminating I/O bottlenecks and applying eager loading via selectinload to prevent MissingGreenlet exceptions.
techDeepDive.why: Guarantees high-throughput non-blocking operations, scaling connection pools efficiently across concurrent academic requests.

techDeepDive.how: Injected mandatory school_id scoping into route dependencies and service boundaries to isolate tenant data across students, teachers, grades, and finance.
techDeepDive.why: Eliminates cross-tenant data leakage risks and IDOR vulnerabilities while keeping a unified, maintainable single-codebase deployment.

techDeepDive.how: Designed a typed React i18n context with zero-flicker hydration for English and Myanmar Unicode, paired with localized schema migrations and 3-way official printable A4 dossiers.
techDeepDive.why: Provides seamless user experience for multilingual school staff, parents, and administrative regulators without layout clipping.

techDeepDive.how: Engineered asynchronous webhooks with HMAC signature verification to dispatch instant parent alerts for attendance, fee invoices, and exam results.
techDeepDive.why: Delivers real-time communication directly to mobile messaging channels with automated delivery guarantees.

roadmap: Redis background task worker queue for asynchronous PDF dossier rendering and scheduled batch parent broadcasts.
High-concurrency composite index tuning with automated PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE monitoring.
Docker Compose multi-stage containerization with Nginx reverse proxy and SSL automation.

items.title: AuraVision: Advanced Assistive Vision System (SmartAV)
items.desc: A real-time assistive technology for visually impaired users. Leverages AI-driven Computer Vision (YOLOE-26N-seg, FaceNet) and LlamaIndex RAG over ChromaDB to provide environmental awareness, hazard tracking, and temporal spatial memory.

techDeepDive.how: Executes high-frequency, low-latency object boundary segmentation (YOLOv26n) and face recognition features (FaceNet-PyTorch) directly on local device frames.
techDeepDive.why: Selected to guarantee 100% on-device visual processing safety and zero cloud execution latency, ensuring visually impaired wearers receive immediate hazard indicators.

techDeepDive.how: Orchestrates complex semantic vector indexing and retrieval pipelines, converting observations into high-dimensional embeddings queryable in natural language.
techDeepDive.why: Chosen because LlamaIndex simplifies index metadata wrapping and temporal query filters (e.g. 'Where were my keys yesterday?'), coupled with ChromaDB's sub-millisecond local vector lookups.

techDeepDive.how: Hosts the asynchronous web API layer and local admin dashboard, employing Authlib and Firebase Auth to isolate multi-user session tokens.
techDeepDive.why: Provides an asynchronous, high-throughput backend server using Uvicorn to stream live spatial maps and update logs with sub-10ms latency.

techDeepDive.how: Processes text synthesis dynamically using Google TTS, passing audio bytes directly into a dedicated Pygame audio device playback loop.
techDeepDive.why: Enables non-blocking voice-feedback response streams that are perfectly synchronized with typing layouts (~50ms latency), maintaining a clean UI flow.

roadmap: Edge hardware compilation: Port neural weights and run deep learning models via ONNX Runtime optimized directly for NVIDIA Jetson Nano / Raspberry Pi 5 wearable rigs.
3D spatial audio: Integrate binaural acoustic spatialization APIs to synthesize 3D sound indicators pointing wearers directly toward object coordinates.
Dynamic Firestore sync: Develop automated cloud metadata synchronization, saving local vector snapshot indexes to Firebase secure stores only when connected to Wi-Fi.

items.title: golf-bookr: Schema & Reservation Engine
items.desc: An interactive reservation platform designed with a highly optimized database schema, managing real-time booking availability, relational user associations, and robust transaction concurrency.

techDeepDive.how: Integrates Gemini LLM via the new @google/generative-ai SDK to build smart slot recommendations and natural language booking query assistance.
techDeepDive.why: Selected to empower users with conversational scheduling interfaces, converting simple sentences (e.g., 'Book a slot for pine valley tomorrow morning') into structured database commands.

techDeepDive.how: Drives the backend server architecture and coordinates active WebSocket links to instantly broadcast schedule state changes across all client screens.
techDeepDive.why: Selected to deliver a sub-50ms real-time experience, ensuring multiple parallel clients view identical slot updates without reloading.

techDeepDive.how: Enforces isolated locking on targeted slot index rows inside MySQL/SQLite databases during booking validation execution.
techDeepDive.why: Chosen to prevent high-traffic race conditions and duplicate booking anomalies, guaranteeing 100% data consistency under high concurrent load.

techDeepDive.how: Performs fast unit and integration tests using Vitest, while securing all user credentials via bcrypt cryptographic hashing.
techDeepDive.why: Bcrypt provides industry-standard salt-hashing, and Vitest delivers automated, blazing-fast transaction concurrency testing.

roadmap: Redis Caching Integration: Set up a Redis database cache to serve available slot reads instantly, dropping database query overhead during high-demand windows.
RabbitMQ Queue Throttling: Implement a message queuing pattern to serialize incoming bookings gracefully when massive tournament events open.
Idempotent Payments: Integrate Stripe payment tokens with idempotent transaction IDs to guarantee bookings are finalized only upon verified payment confirmation.

items.title: TikTok ABM: Agent-Based Data Simulator
items.desc: A simulation framework built in Python to model and analyze user interactions, content recommendation algorithms, and viral network dynamics on the TikTok platform.

techDeepDive.how: Simulates 500 virtual consumer agents with individual personality types (Innovators, Followers, Skeptics) progressing through 3-stage marketing funnels.
techDeepDive.why: Selected as the leading Python multi-agent model framework, providing built-in scheduler grids and robust agent step orchestrations.

techDeepDive.how: Scrapes actual TikTok trending metrics, page view statistics, and user sentiments using Selenium stealth configurations.
techDeepDive.why: Chosen to bypass web scraping blocker scripts, ensuring the simulation is initialized with authentic Songkran festival seasonal trend data.

techDeepDive.how: Renders a modern, responsive React-in-Python web dashboard showing dynamic, interactive Plotly network graph layouts and conversion metrics.
techDeepDive.why: Solara permits building state-of-the-art interactive dashboards entirely in Python without complex Node.js setups, keeping codebases unified.

techDeepDive.how: Maps connection edges among virtual users via small-world network graphs in NetworkX to simulate authentic word-of-mouth info cascades.
techDeepDive.why: Chosen over random networks to accurately model real-world social clustering, where users prefer trends shared by close friends.

roadmap: Reinforcement learning agents: Train virtual consumers using deep Q-learning networks to model self-adaptive behavior based on content feed interactions.
Neo4j graph migration: Port graph models into a real-time Neo4j instance to scale active simulation capacity to thousands of nodes.
Linguistic sentiment modeling: Implement local Transformer pipelines to dynamically update agent sentiment parameters based on review streams.

items.title: HDFS: Distributed Storage Explorer
items.desc: An analytical visualizer designed to simulate distributed storage filesystems, modeling chunk replication, NameNode operations, and distributed data pipelines.

techDeepDive.how: Orchestrates a 12-container distributed infrastructure ecosystem including HDFS (NameNode/DataNodes), Apache Spark, Hive, and MongoDB.
techDeepDive.why: Built to simulate a true production-scale big data cluster locally on WSL2, providing separate network layers for storage and compute engines.

techDeepDive.how: Executes massive distributed analytical DAG queries over transactional datasets, loading data partitions directly from HDFS files.
techDeepDive.why: Selected because of Spark's lightning-fast in-memory processing speeds and robust API support for handling raw tabular telemetry.

techDeepDive.how: Manages schema models, catalogs, and structured corporate tables over raw HDFS files using PostgreSQL as the central Metastore database.
techDeepDive.why: Allows querying storage backends natively via SQL, bridging the gap between raw distributed files and structured relational tables.

techDeepDive.how: Runs PyThaiNLP's custom 'newmm' word segmentation inside a Spark User-Defined Function (UDF) to analyze Thai shop review sentiment streams.
techDeepDive.why: Selected because standard tokenizers cannot parse Thai language words, enabling high-performance Spark sentiment analysis for local e-commerce.

roadmap: Erasure Coding (HDFS 3.x): Implement Erasure Coding simulations (Reed-Solomon 6+3) to show storage footprint reduction from 3x to 1.5x while keeping identical fault tolerance.
Active-Active NameNode Topology: Upgrade the high-availability simulation to model Quorum Journal Managers (QJM) and Apache ZooKeeper synchronization.
Automated Block Balancer: Build a block rebalancing utility simulator that automatically redistributes block densities when a new DataNode joins the rack.

items.title: Fraud-Detection: Transaction Anomaly Classifier
items.desc: A machine learning data pipeline designed to preprocess large financial datasets, perform feature engineering, and classify fraudulent transactions using ensemble anomaly detection models.

techDeepDive.how: Processes incoming transaction streams through three storage tiers: Bronze (append JSONL), Silver (validated schema CSV with ML risk flags), and Gold (KPI aggregates).
techDeepDive.why: Selected to enforce absolute data governance, schema validation, and audit tracking across the ingestion pipeline, ensuring compliance with PCI-DSS.

techDeepDive.how: Ensembles predictions from XGBoost (supervised, 40%), Isolation Forest (unsupervised outlier detection, 25%), and a custom PyTorch LSTM (deep sequence, 35%).
techDeepDive.why: XGBoost catches known fraud targets, Isolation Forest detects zero-day anomalies, and the PyTorch LSTM parses sequential history to identify temporal 'Smurfing' patterns.

techDeepDive.how: Streams transactions via Kafka Producers/Consumers, while managing sub-millisecond customer velocity features in a Redis cache.
techDeepDive.why: Enables high-throughput, low-latency live evaluations, letting the system calculate velocity indicators and predict risk in under 10ms per transaction.

techDeepDive.how: Monitors model data and concept drift using Evidently metrics, compiling interactive graphs inside a Streamlit administration portal.
techDeepDive.why: Provides an intuitive dashboard for risk analysts, automatically alerting developers when changes in user transaction behavior degrade model precision.

roadmap: Apache Flink stream processing: Port consumer logic to Apache Flink for true stateful stream computations and millisecond event window calculations.
Autoencoder reconstruction models: Train unsupervised PyTorch Autoencoders to score transaction risk based on feature reconstruction error spikes.
Active human feedback loops: Build transaction alert simulation loops, automatically retraining ML weights when users confirm suspicious alerts.

items.title: Databricks-Fraud: Distributed Transaction Anomaly Pipeline
items.desc: A cloud-native, distributed fraud detection system engineered on Databricks. Implements a Medallion Lakehouse architecture using Spark Structured Streaming and Delta Lake, featuring automated model tracking and lifecycle management through MLflow.

techDeepDive.how: Processes parallel batch files and high-velocity transactional streams using Spark Structured Streaming directly on auto-scaling clusters.
techDeepDive.why: Ensures horizontal scaling capability for multi-million row datasets, reducing end-to-end data transformation latency to seconds.

techDeepDive.how: Establishes a three-tier ACID-compliant data lake: Bronze (raw ingestion logs), Silver (schema-validated tables with engineered features), and Gold (fraud KPI reporting metrics).
techDeepDive.why: Guarantees absolute schema enforcement, time-travel history auditing, and reliable transactional read/write consistency.

techDeepDive.how: Automatically tracks hyperparameter runs, logs model artifacts, registers candidate models, and handles stage transitions (Staging, Production) within Databricks.
techDeepDive.why: Provides complete model governance, reproducibility, and a clear audit trail for compliance in financial classification systems.

techDeepDive.how: Trains ensemble classification models (XGBoost, Random Forest) on distributed features, optimizing hyperparameters via Spark MLlib tuning loops.
techDeepDive.why: Achieves high precision and recall on imbalanced transaction logs, capturing complex non-linear fraud signatures.

roadmap: Databricks Workflows Orchestration: Automate daily retraining runs and data validation stages using native Databricks workflows and alerts.
Real-time Model Serving: Deploy registered champion models directly onto Databricks serverless real-time endpoints for sub-50ms REST API inferences.
Unity Catalog Integration: Enforce cell-level security policies and column-level lineage tracking over the entire Medallion pipeline.

weeks.title: Week 1: Multi-Tenant Architecture v2.0 & Security Hardening
weeks.summary: Local environment setup, tenant-level data isolation, credential sanitization, Parent Portal (/dashboard/my-children), and bulk CSV onboarding with database savepoints.
tasks: Configured local FastAPI + PostgreSQL + Next.js environment and conducted architecture audit of handover documentation.
Architected Multi-Tenant Engine v2.0 with school-level data isolation and dynamic feature toggles.
Remediated security issues: eliminated hardcoded bootstrap secrets, deleted debug routes, and centralized JWT decoding helpers.
Implemented Parent Portal module with parent-student relationship mapping and child overview dashboard.
Engineered bulk CSV onboarding engine for students and teachers with atomic rollback savepoints (db.begin_nested()).
concepts: Multi-Tenant Relational Database Architecture
Row-Level Security & Tenant Scoping
Stateless JWT Authentication & Secret Hardening
Atomic Database Savepoints & Ingestion Safety

problems.problem: Cross-Tenant Data Leakage in Single-Tenant Queries: Initial queries lacked school_id filters, risking unauthorized cross-school record access.
problems.solution: Injected mandatory school_id scoping into backend route dependencies (verify_class_access, verify_student_access), returning 404/403 for mismatched tenant access.

problems.problem: Hardcoded Secrets & Duplicate Token Decoding: Discovered fallback credentials in code and four divergent implementations of base64 token parsing.
problems.solution: Enforced strict environment variable loading (BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD) and consolidated client token handling into a single robust decodeTokenPayload() helper.

weeks.title: Week 2: Examinations, School Finance, Automated Webhook Bots & Test Suite
weeks.summary: Exam scheduling & report card generation, multi-line fee invoices & payslips, academic year promotions, Telegram & Viber bot alerts, and 56-test regression suite.
tasks: Built Examinations & Grading module: exam timetables, class mark entry, grade boundaries, and automated report card generator.
Developed School Finance & Payroll: fee structures, multi-line invoices, payment slip verification, and teacher payslips.
Implemented Academic Promotions Engine for class-to-class student progression and academic year rollovers.
Integrated automated messaging bots (Viber Bot & Telegram Bot) via secure webhooks for real-time parent notifications.
Hardened security with atomic counter tables for race-safe invoice numbering, IDOR checks, magic-byte file validation, and built a 56-test regression suite.
concepts: Concurrent Database Locking & Race-Safe Document Counters
OWASP IDOR Mitigation & Magic-Byte File Validation
Event-Driven Webhook Architectures (Telegram & Viber Bot APIs)
Automated Test-Driven Development with Pytest & TestClient

problems.problem: Concurrent Document Number Generation Collisions: Parallel transactions read identical latest invoice numbers, causing duplicate document collisions.
problems.solution: Implemented dedicated transactional counter tables with atomic updates and database locks within nested savepoints, guaranteeing strictly contiguous numbering.

problems.problem: Cross-Tenant Information Leakage via Document Lookups (IDOR): Administrators could potentially query invoices or results belonging to other schools.
problems.solution: Added strict tenant-scoping checks inside invoice and exam access dependencies, returning 404 Not Found whenever school IDs do not match the authenticated session.

weeks.title: Week 3: Dynamic Custom Fields Studio & Granular Staff Governance
weeks.summary: Visual schema builder for custom entity attributes, Alembic JSON storage migrations, registration form slide-overs, UTF-8 BOM CSV exports, and granular staff role bundles.
tasks: Architected and implemented Multi-Entity Dynamic Custom Fields Studio across Students, Teachers, and Parents.
Executed database schema extensions with Alembic migrations for JSON-based dynamic field storage (e2f3a4b5c6d7, c1d2e3f4a5b6).
Integrated dynamic custom fields into registration forms, Quick-Peek slide-over drawers, and printable A4 dossiers.
Engineered dynamic CSV data export engine supporting custom field headers with UTF-8 BOM encoding for Unicode scripts.
Constructed granular Staff Role Governance (Registrar, HR Officer, Finance Officer, Headmaster) and automated test suite (test_custom_fields.py).
concepts: Dynamic JSON Schema Storage in Relational Databases
Zero-Downtime Alembic Schema Migrations
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Administrative Delegation
UTF-8 BOM Stream Processing for Multilingual File Exports

problems.problem: Schema Sprawl & Performance Degradation from Entity Alterations: Adding ad-hoc entity columns risked database schema bloat and migration overhead.
problems.solution: Architected centralized JSON definitions in School.settings paired with a generic custom_fields JSON column on entity tables, allowing limitless dynamic attributes.

problems.problem: Non-ASCII Character Garbling (Mojibake) in CSV Exports: Non-Latin characters in custom field data displayed corrupted text in spreadsheet applications.
problems.solution: Injected a UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (\ufeff) at the head of generated CSV streams, ensuring Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets render Unicode accurately.

weeks.title: Week 4: Full-Stack Bilingual i18n Engine & Official Printable Dossiers
weeks.summary: Typed React i18n context (English & Myanmar Unicode), database schema localization (Subject.name_mm), 3-way official printable A4 document mode switchers, and UI typography modernization.
tasks: Designed and integrated full-stack Bilingual Internationalization (i18n) Engine supporting English and Myanmar Unicode with zero-flicker hydration.
Applied database schema localization via Alembic migrations (a1b2c3d4e5f6) adding Subject.name_mm and User.language_preference.
Engineered 3-Way Official Document Mode Switchers (Official Myanmar, English, and Side-by-Side Bilingual) for A4 dossiers and payment receipts.
Built bilingual message template composers for automated Telegram and Viber parent notification bots.
Modernized entire frontend iconography using lucide-react vector SVG system and developed bilingual test suite (test_i18n_models_and_services.py).
concepts: Full-Stack Internationalization (i18n) & Localized Schema Design
Complex Script Typography & Line-Height Collision Mitigation
Print Media Stylesheet Architecture (@media print) & Clamped Layouts
Bilingual Notification Pipelines & Bot Template Formatting

problems.problem: Text Clipping & Diacritic Collisions with Myanmar Unicode: Default tight line-heights caused stacked diacritics to clip in navigation badges and table cells.
problems.solution: Adjusted typography utilities to leading-normal and leading-relaxed on localized text containers and defined custom font metrics in Tailwind.

problems.problem: Layout Bleed in Printable A4 Documents When Switching Languages: Longer localized phrases pushed single-page receipts and dossiers onto unwanted second pages.
problems.solution: Implemented compact @media print rules, dynamic font clamp rules, and two-column layouts to ensure official documents strictly fit one standard A4 sheet.

weeks.title: Week 5: Modern Tooling (uv), Async SQLAlchemy 2.0 & High-Throughput Migration
weeks.summary: Migration to Astral's uv and pyproject.toml, full persistence refactor to Async SQLAlchemy 2.0 with asyncpg, resolving MissingGreenlet lazy-load exceptions, and UTC timezone standardization.
tasks: Migrated backend dependency management to Astral's uv package manager and pyproject.toml with deterministic uv.lock lockfiles.
Refactored entire persistence layer to Async SQLAlchemy 2.0 with asyncpg (PostgreSQL) and aiosqlite (SQLite).
Executed asynchronous refactoring across all 16 feature modules (services, routers, authentication guards, and permissions).
Resolved asynchronous ORM lazy-loading pitfalls (MissingGreenlet) and tuned connection pooling strategy.
Standardized UTC timezone serialization for asyncpg, eliminated legacy dead code, and upgraded integration tests to httpx.AsyncClient.
concepts: Astral uv Package Management & PEP 518/621 Standards
Async SQLAlchemy 2.0 & Non-Blocking Asynchronous I/O
Eager Loading Strategies (selectinload, joinedload) to prevent Greenlet errors
Database Connection Pool Tuning & UTC Timezone Serialization

problems.problem: MissingGreenlet Exceptions on Relational Attribute Access: In async mode, accessing unloaded relations implicitly caused runtime crashes.
problems.solution: Audited all ORM model queries and applied explicit eager loading via selectinload() and joinedload(), converting computed properties into explicit service queries.

problems.problem: asyncpg Timezone-Aware vs. Naive Datetime Rejection: PostgreSQL strictly rejected timezone-naive datetimes during authentication timestamp updates.
problems.solution: Standardized all server timestamp generations to explicit UTC timezone-aware objects (datetime.now(timezone.utc)), ensuring seamless cross-database serialization.

weeks.title: Week 6: Performance Profiling & Query Optimization
weeks.summary: Executing database index benchmarks on PostgreSQL with EXPLAIN ANALYZE and tuning high-concurrency API latency.
tasks: Benchmarking slow relational queries with EXPLAIN ANALYZE on PostgreSQL async connections.
Refactoring composite indexes across multi-tenant parent-student lookup tables.
Load testing asynchronous FastAPI endpoints under concurrent user spikes.
concepts: Database Indexing Optimization & Query Plans
